home.title: Buuggaaga qoraalka ee istuudiyaha
home.trying: Waxaad Glazecalc ku tijaabinaysaa sida {name}. Ku bilow hab.
home.welcomeBack: Ka sii wad meeshii aad ka joogsatay.

welcome.heading: Ku soo dhowow Glazecalc
welcome.text: Buuggaaga qoraalku waa diyaar. Tallaabo hore oo wanaagsan: ku qor glaze aad hore u isku qasto, walxihiisa iyo qadarkooda, oo arag unity formula-diisa.
welcome.confirm: Xaqiiji email-kaaga: waxaan link u dirnay {email}. Galitaanka laba-tallaabo ayaa u baahan. <account>Bogga akoonkaagu</account> mar kale ayuu diri karaa.
welcome.confirmText: Waxaan link u dirnay {email}. Fur si aad u xaqiijiso in cinwaanku adiga kuu yahay: galitaanka laba-tallaabo ayaa u baahan. <account>Bogga akoonkaagu</account> mar kale ayuu diri karaa.

recipe.title: Habab
recipe.text: Ka dhis glaze walxo iyo qadar, arag unity formula-diisa, oo kaydi.

import.title: Ku dheji habab
import.text: Ku dheji habab laga keenay website, spreadsheet ama qoraallo, hubi waxa la akhriyay, oo kaydi.

blends.title: Isku-darka test tile-yada
blends.text: Isku dar laba, saddex ama afar ka mid ah hababkaaga, una samee test tile-yo lambaraysan, oo leh waxa loo miisaamayo mid kasta.

material.title: Walxo
material.text: Ku dar walxo ceeriin oo adiga kuu gaar ah, laga keenay formula kiimiko ama falanqaynta iibiyaha.

additive.title: Walxo lagu daro iyo midabeeyeyaal
additive.text: Hay midabeeyeyaasha iyo walxaha iftiinka ka celiya inuu dhex maro (opacifier) ee aad ku darto glaze aasaasi ah dushiisa.

firing.title: Diiwaanka gubidda
firing.text: Qor waqtiyada, heerkulka iyo cone-yada gubid kasta.

notes.title: Qoraallo
notes.text: Hay natiijooyinka tijaabooyinka iyo wax kasta oo kale oo mudan in la xasuusto.

advice.title: Talooyin glaze
advice.text: Talooyin ku saabsan isku-qasidda, glaze-marinta iyo gubidda, iyo talooyinkaaga.

guides.title: Hagayaal
guides.text: Laga bilaabo waxa glaze yahay ilaa gubiddiisa, iyo sida qof walba loo ilaaliyo inta lagu jiro.

trash.title: Qashinka
trash.text: Dib u celi waxa aad ka saartay 30-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay.

account.title: Akoonka iyo dejinta
account.text: Dejinta, furaha sirta, galitaanka laba-tallaabo, iyo soo dejinta wax kasta oo aad halkan ku hayso.

home.newHere: Ma ku cusub tahay unity formula? <advice>Bogga talooyinku</advice> wuxuu sharxaa aasaaska, <about>bogga ku saabsanna</about> wuxuu sheegaa sida Glazecalc u shaqeeyo.
